% This file makes a web version of the blueprint
% It should include all the \usepackage needed for this version.
% The template includes standard AMS packages.
% It is otherwise a very minimal preamble (you should probably at least
% add cleveref and tikz-cd).

\documentclass{report}

\usepackage{amssymb, amsthm, amsmath}
\usepackage{hyperref}
% The default thms= is definition+lemma+proposition+theorem+corollary,
% which leaves the `assumption` environment (macros/common.tex) entirely
% invisible in the auto-generated dependency graph -- the five interface
% nodes a proved theorem's chain passes through (lem:comparison,
% rmk:nofinitesub, eq:padicbsd, prop:jetformula, def:classsums) would not
% appear at all. Adding +assumption restores them as graph nodes; they
% render with the distinct "Assumption" header and, since \leanok is never
% applied to them (by the fence rule), never receive the green "proved" fill
% that theorem/lemma/proposition/corollary nodes get once \leanok'd -- so
% they stay visually distinct from proved nodes even though plasTeX's default
% shape map only special-cases `definition` for a box (everything else,
% assumption included, renders as an ellipse; see
% plastexdepgraph/Packages/depgraph.py). Verified: `bp web` stays green
% and dep_graph_document.html renders all five nodes.
\usepackage[showmore, dep_graph, thms=definition+lemma+proposition+theorem+corollary+assumption]{blueprint}


\input{macros/common}
\input{macros/web}

% \home is where this blueprint is served: GitHub Pages serves a project
% repository at https://<user>.github.io/<repo>/, and the Pages workflow stages
% the blueprint into a blueprint/ subdirectory of that site.
%
% \github and \dochome are empty deliberately.  A \github link would fail for a
% reader while the repository is private; set it to
% https://github.com/BarinderBanwait/rank2sha at go-live.  \dochome needs
% doc-gen4 API documentation published alongside, which needs doc-gen4 as a Lake
% dependency; while it is empty the declaration links resolve to /find/, which
% does not exist, and the Pages workflow strips them so the names render as
% plain text.
\home{https://barinderbanwait.github.io/rank2sha/blueprint/}
\github{}
\dochome{}

\title{Second derivatives of $p$-adic $L$-functions and the Shafarevich--Tate group of rank-two CM elliptic curves: formalization blueprint}
\author{Barinder S. Banwait}
